description: BCM2712 (Pi 5, CM5) boards: the boot ROM's USB boot, the mass-storage gadget that exposes the eMMC, and the bootloader EEPROM images. The board-OS boot mechanism is this family's Gaia layer (rpi-bcm2712/gaia).
entry: Hold the board's boot button while connecting its USB port to this computer.
The board appears as 0a5c:2712 (BCM2712 boot ROM).

stages: usb-boot: the boot ROM takes the mass-storage-gadget boot files, or the board's flasher bundle
write: the eMMC is written over USB (the flasher writes and verifies it on the board)

files.notes: Bootloader image with bootconf.txt embedded. Flash as pieeprom.bin (rpiboot recovery) or pieeprom.upd (in-OS self-update).
rpi-eeprom-digest file (sha256 of the image plus timestamp), not a cryptographic signature. Use as pieeprom.sig.
rpi-eeprom recovery.bin for BCM2712 from release v2025.12.08-2712, matching the bundled pieeprom. The EEPROM flashing tool rpiboot loads as the second stage. Kept in git (about 100 KB).
